description: Searches the Strale capability registry by keyword, category, or natural language query. Returns matching capabilities and bundles with slugs, descriptions and input fields where available. Bundle prices are integer EUR cents in price_cents, with price_formatted for display and price as a compatibility alias. Capability prices are null in discovery; null does not mean free. For capabilities, is_free_tier identifies tools that run without payment; anonymous calls have a monthly per-IP allowance. No API key required to search.

category.description: Filter by category: compliance, validation, data-extraction, developer-tools, web3, security, domain-intel, recruiting, sales, legal, text

offset.description: Number of results to skip (for pagination). Default: 0

query.description: Search keyword (matched against name, description, slug)

name: strale_search
title: Search tools and bundles
